title: UN Commission finding on West Bank education and settler attacks
summary: The Commission assessed the effects of military operations, access restrictions, demolitions and settler attacks on Palestinian education in the West Bank.
claim: The Commission found that more than 806,000 students were affected and that Israel had done little to prevent or prosecute settlers who intentionally targeted educational facilities to terrorize communities and force them from their homes.
legal_characterization: Factual and legal finding by a UN commission of inquiry concerning the occupying Power's protection obligations; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraphs 82-83 of A/HRC/59/26. The record attributes the protection-obligation finding to the Commission and keeps the scope limited to education-related harms discussed there.
